svg.text: FIG. 03 Three Key Areas — Detailed Design

g.text: Positioning: Garden-type full-stack autonomous innovation park
Qinghe AI eco-observation station · Waterfront innovation frontage
Model red-team test field · Standard-setting workshop
Safety governance sandbox · Low-carbon compute station
• Qinghe Innovation Frontage — AI eco-observation & showcase along north bank
• Acceleration Core — Model red-team testing + Standard-setting + Evaluation
• Standard & Governance — Safety sandbox open for visits & booking
Positioning: Campus-adjacent tech transfer & talent community
Open-source release hall · Code contribution showcase · Mini roadshow
Campus incubation hub · AI education points
Talent apartments · Night co-work · Service center
• Open Source Axis — Release corridor linking Wudaokou & Heritage Park
• Tech Transfer Street — Campus incubation + AI education points
• Talent Living Zone — Apartments + Night co-work + Service center
Positioning: Urban intelligent economy & intl. exchange district
International conference center · Smart commerce district
Urban AI showcase · Transit hub complex
• Intl. Roadshow Hall — Global AI Innovation Week roadshows & conferences
• Data Element Hall — AI enterprise HQ + Data trading platform
• Smart Terminal Street — Urban AI showcase + Transit hub complex
